frontmatter.name: land
frontmatter.description: Land the current Solix terminal — close its window/viewers while the shell keeps running on the host, cached for later resume. Use when asked to land/park this terminal or wrap up and exit a Solix session.

frontmatter.name: load
frontmatter.description: Load Helm register items into THIS chat — secrets, skills, docs, values, commands, files, or the whole Helm. The operator picks all-vs-one in a Mac popup the agent never sees; selected items are inserted as incoming work.

frontmatter.name: mcp
frontmatter.description: Wire Solix as an MCP server (`solix mcp` stdio, `solix mcp --cloud` to the production Cloudflare MCP) so a chat can send work to First Mate, or tidy MCP servers across agent CLIs — find failed, redundant, and disabled servers, remove the dead ones, and reauthorize expired OAuth. Use when asked to expose Solix to ChatGPT/Claude/Grok, add a Solix MCP connector, clean up, dedupe, fix, or reauth MCPs, or when an agent reports an MCP 'Needs authentication' or 'Failed to connect'.
